authority: User selected same-clock 61.44 MHz PWM and Vivado VIO board controls
scope: Bounded one-window board control, truthful evidence storage and export, physical PWM isolation; frozen source/algorithm remains read-only
claim_boundary: Controller/storage/gating functional simulation is not full algorithm or official-IP simulation, timing closure or board acceptance

controls.method: Four VIO output probes: control32, context160, mapping96, read_select32
controls.reset: Capture VIO action baseline first; retained toggles are not new commands
controls.priority: STOP suppresses new motion/START, even same edge. Conflicting non-STOP actions reject without queuing
controls.atomicity: COMMIT snapshots context and map fields; READ/FETCH/DUMP snapshot read selection
controls.observe: Default observe=1,mapping_present=0,motion_permission=0; no fabricated mechanical limits, no arm or physical PWM
controls.run: Exactly one explicit START authorization per actual window; no autonomous rearm

start_contract: COMMIT validates fields and uses actual diag_config_valid/ready handshake
START waits real diag_frontend_ready before start rising edge then diag_start; no fixed-delay ready assumption
Actual frontend warmup is 4096 samples at 48 kHz; controller unit test models readiness signal, not fake audio or FFT
Block FFT data/status permit during identity binding and motion arm, but allow required fault/STOP draining
First sampled new ff_busy contains stable source identity; early abort/terminal/M-offer rejects late qualification
Motion mode arm LOW then HIGH, wait true current_qualified before permit
Observe mode no arm/map and no wait for qualification; still process raw numeric chain
No watchdog extension; existing 23-bit watchdog is about 136.53 ms
stop_recovery: STOP revokes new command/arm and lowers source start but does not cold-reset or erase evidence
Report and ABORT capture/ACK and IP/source draining continue after STOP
Warm recovery uses actual diag_reset request; wait true idle/config_ready/quiet/no obligation and AXIS drained
Next START requires explicit record export/release and new COMMIT/START, never automatic success on timeout

storage.report: Separate full slot: identity725, terminal6626, frontend ABORT seen/identity725/payload180, policy64, numeric/mapping/eligibility, command and aligned next-edge servo observation, sequence/time
storage.backend_abort: Independent slot; simultaneous report and ABORT must both be retained
storage.report_timing: Capture handshake pre-edge facts; associate following registered accept/reject with same report identity
storage.backpressure: Ready only with real slot capacity; no overwrite and no ready based on motor accept
storage.diagnostic: 64x32 bits; accepted words1..63. Preserve partial errors
storage.fetch: Select snapshot, validate sequence/ordered word/words/last, store data before exact ACK; at least one low ACK cycle between words
storage.invalid_fetch: No false ACK/pop or bank clearing on malformed sequence/word/count/last. Explicit read-abort aborts snapshot only
storage.dump: Frozen complete data emitted as 32-bit stream with type/word/count/sequence/valid/last; terminal208,identity23,abort6,diag up to63 words
storage.release: DUMP may repeat without mutation. Only explicit permitted RELEASE frees selected complete stored record

physical_pwm.default: Physical outputs LOW after cold reset even though internal core generates reset pulses
physical_pwm.open: Only legal explicit motion config; each gate opens while internal PWM LOW, never mid high pulse
physical_pwm.stop: STOP retains already-open gate and old PWM target; it is NOT a PWM-off/emergency-power control
physical_pwm.mechanical: Actual allowed bounds and reset clearance UNKNOWN; do not guess them

acceptance: Warmup and one-shot toggle handling including reset baseline and simultaneous actions
Real identity binding, context mismatch and early terminal rejection, arm before permits
Observe no arm/motion while accepting numeric results
STOP+START and STOP+report same-edge behavior; no stale authorization after recovery
Separate report/abort slots, full backpressure, aligned delayed servo observation
Random fetch stalls, sequence/count/order/last errors, partial abort and no destructive ACK
Exact all-word dump/read for terminal208,identity23,abort6,diag63, repeated dump and restricted release
PWM default low, low-phase opening, cold reset and STOP retaining opened output
Independent input/expected event scoreboard with meaningful isolated negative canaries
native_full_build: User executes GUI integration and official IP generation/build. Agent does not modify D project or program board.
